text: Harper Festival and Harper Audio present Pete the Cat's Wacky Taco Tuesday by Kimberly and James Dean performed by James Foey. Today is Pete the Cat's favorite day of the week. That's because today is Taco Tuesday. On the weight of the taqueria, Pete daydreams about all the tasty tacos he's going to eat. Should he have a pineapple taco, an avocado taco, or a fish taco, or all three? Pineapple, avocado, fish. He wants them all. Oh no, there is a problem. The taqueria is closed. This is not groovy at all, Bob says. Now what are we going to eat? Pete doesn't panic. He knows what to do. Let's make our own tacos. Dad makes rad taco shells. Bob is awesome at making salsa and Mom's fish is far out. Yeah, the family cheers. Back at home, Bob, Mom, Dad and Pete get right to work. When the dough is ready, Pete starts to roll it into small balls. Then he has a better idea. He gets a big rolling pin and rolls them into great big shells. Groovy, Bob says. Giant taco shells. Pete nods. Now we can fill them with even more tasty treats. Uh oh. Dad forgot to go to the store. They are all out of beans and cheese. No worries, Pete says. We can use these instead. Pete holds up a jar of marshmallow fluff and a bag of jelly beans. Bob fills his taco with pickles and bananas. Yum! Dad fills his with berries and cream. Mom makes a green taco. Cucumbers, peppers and broccoli. It's Pete's turn to fill his taco. He chooses jelly beans and marshmallow fluff. Then he adds some maple syrup. Sweet! Pete says. Too sweet! Mom says. Pete looks at his taco. Mom's right. It needs something else. But what? Pickles? No. Mustard? No. Then Pete sees what he wants. Anchovies! Pete takes a big bite. Now that is one groovy taco, he says. Pete hears a knock on the door. It was Pete's friends, Callie, Gus and Grumpy Toad. What smells so good? Callie asks. Can we try? Asks Gus. Even Grumpy Toad wants a taco. Wow! These tacos are out of sight, Callie shouts. Grumpy Toad agrees. Best tacos I've ever had. We should do this every Taco Tuesday, Mom says. Pete grins. Making tacos was fun. But I'd rather eat them.
